experiments.label: M1
experiments.title: Original embeddings and regularized temporal heads
experiments.hypothesis: Regularization can improve validation RMSE over a matched WindNet architecture port while preserving correlation.
experiments.method: Original GoogLeNet weights, identical image windows; three-seed LSTM baseline and 18 ridge candidates. Original Folds1–3 fit, Fold4 validation.
experiments.success_criteria: At least 1% lower validation RMSE with Pearson r no worse than the matched baseline; report chi-square and original HSE threat score.
